base.title: Merge catalog slices into a unified work-unit catalog with collision detection
base.question_or_target: Build a deterministic merger that reads command-center/catalog-slices/*.json, allocates ids under the 2048-unit floor, refuses overlapping identifiers with a collision gate, and proves order-independence plus idempotence on repeated merges. The mechanism is slice consolidation with an explicit collision detector.
